[IDAT.3.3.4] **Transfer is single and success-only.** On a
successful `ds_json_array_append` / `ds_json_object_set` the
container takes ownership of the child: freeing the container
frees it, and freeing the child again is a double-free. On error
ownership does NOT move — the child is not consumed and the
container is left unchanged, so the caller must free the child.
This makes error cleanup deterministic. `ds_json_object_set`
copies its key, and when the key is already present it replaces
the value (freeing the old), so a built object holds one value per
key. A parsed one does too: `ds_json_parse` refuses text that
repeats a key in one object ([LGRA.5.8.7]).
